## Sales and Revenue

### Automate Lead Prospecting

**Problem:** Your SDR spends 3 hours/day researching leads manually.

**Result:** Ask your AI "Find 20 SaaS companies in Berlin with 50-200 employees that raised Series A in the last 6 months" and get a qualified list with emails, LinkedIn profiles, and company data — in 30 seconds.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "companies": { "url": "${VINKIUS_CRUNCHBASE_MCP_URL}" },
    "emails": { "url": "${VINKIUS_HUNTER_MCP_URL}" },
    "enrichment": { "url": "${VINKIUS_APOLLOIO_MCP_URL}" },
    "crm": { "url": "${VINKIUS_HUBSPOT_MCP_URL}" }
  }
}
```

**How it works:**
1. AI searches Crunchbase for companies matching your criteria
2. Hunter finds decision-maker emails
3. Apollo enriches with job titles, company size, tech stack
4. Results are pushed to HubSpot as qualified leads

Deploy: [Crunchbase](https://vinkius.com/en/apps/crunchbase-mcp) · [Hunter](https://vinkius.com/en/apps/hunter-mcp) · [Apollo](https://vinkius.com/en/apps/apolloio-mcp) · [HubSpot](https://vinkius.com/en/apps/hubspot-crm-full-mcp)

## How It Works

Every use case above follows the same pattern:

1. **Deploy** the MCP servers you need from [vinkius.com](https://vinkius.com)
2. **Create** a `.mcp.json` file in your project with the configuration shown
3. **Set** environment variables with your SSE endpoint URLs
4. **Ask** your AI assistant (Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client) in natural language

The AI automatically discovers the connected tools and uses them to answer your questions with **real, live data** — not hallucinated responses.
